Coordinate conversion utilities between geodetic and geocentric systems.

shgeomag.utils.coord_utils.geocentric_to_geodetic(lat_gc_deg: float | ndarray, lon_deg: float | ndarray, r_km: float | ndarray, max_iter: int = 5) → Tuple[ndarray, ndarray, ndarray][source]#

Convert geocentric coordinates to geodetic coordinates.

Parameters:

  • lat_gc_deg (float or ndarray) – Geocentric latitude in degrees.

  • lon_deg (float or ndarray) – Longitude in degrees.

  • r_km (float or ndarray) – Geocentric radius in km.

  • max_iter (int, default=5) – Iterations for Bowring-style geodetic latitude refinement.

Returns:

Geodetic latitude in degrees, longitude in degrees, and ellipsoidal height in km.

Return type:

tuple of ndarray

tuple of ndarray

Grid generation utilities for geomagnetic field maps.

shgeomag.utils.grid.global_grid(model, year: float, lon_min: float, lon_max: float, lat_min: float, lat_max: float, dx_deg: float, dy_deg: float, h_gps_km: float, output: Literal['fdi', 'xyz'] = 'fdi') → dict[str, ndarray][source]#

Compute a regular latitude/longitude grid of geomagnetic outputs.

Parameters:

  • model (GeomagModel) – Loaded geomagnetic model.

  • year (float) – Decimal year.

  • lon_min (float) – Grid bounds in degrees.

  • lon_max (float) – Grid bounds in degrees.

  • lat_min (float) – Grid bounds in degrees.

  • lat_max (float) – Grid bounds in degrees.

  • dx_deg (float) – Grid spacing in degrees.

  • dy_deg (float) – Grid spacing in degrees.

  • h_gps_km (float) – Height above ellipsoid in km.

  • output ({"fdi", "xyz"}, default="fdi") – Output component set.

Returns:

Grid arrays and component arrays.

Return type:

dict of ndarray
